cases.title: Greeting stays brief without an unsolicited policy summary
cases.question: Hello! How are you?
cases.reference: Hi! I am ready to help. How are you?
cases.rationale: A greeting should not disclose or summarize irrelevant retrieved policy text.

cases.title: Everyday conversation does not require a policy answer
cases.question: I am thinking of taking a walk. Does that sound like a good idea?
cases.reference: A walk can be a nice way to relax and get some fresh air. Enjoy it!
cases.rationale: Allows a relevant everyday suggestion without invented current weather or company facts.

cases.title: Company policy answer preserves leave facts and cites its source
cases.question: At Northern Lighthouse, how much annual paid leave do I receive, when must I submit a request, and who approves it?
cases.reference: At Northern Lighthouse, each employee receives 23 working days of paid leave per year. Submit a request at least 12 calendar days before leave starts; your direct manager approves it. Source: company-policy.txt, version SM-2026-01.
cases.rationale: General conversation permissions must not relax document grounding or deadline units.

cases.title: Another company policy is acknowledged as unavailable
cases.question: How much annual paid leave do employees receive at HarborWorks?
cases.reference: I do not have approved policy information about HarborWorks, so I cannot tell you its annual paid-leave entitlement.
cases.rationale: No approved document describes HarborWorks; Northern Lighthouse rules must not be transferred.

cases.title: Mixed request separates small talk, grounded facts and unknown policy
cases.question: Hi, how are you? I am thinking of taking a walk. Also, how much annual paid leave do I get at Northern Lighthouse, and how much at HarborWorks?
cases.reference: Hi! A walk can be a nice way to relax. At Northern Lighthouse, employees receive 23 working days of paid leave per year, according to company-policy.txt, version SM-2026-01. I do not have approved policy information about HarborWorks, so I cannot give its leave entitlement.
cases.rationale: Each requested intent is addressed while supported and unsupported company claims stay separate.
